description: Source code for the SkillsInjectionHook class, which implements pre- and post-processing hooks for skill management, code execution, and conversation loop handling in a LiteLLM proxy system.

classes.name: SkillsInjectionHook
classes.description: A custom logger class implementing pre- and post-call hooks to process skills, convert them for different API formats, inject content, execute code snippets, and manage conversation loops within the LiteLLM proxy framework.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Processes skills from container before the LLM call, fetching skill details from the database and converting skills as necessary based on model type.

methods.name: dict _process_for_messages_api( self, data: dict, litellm_skills: List[LiteLLM_SkillsTable], use_anthropic_format: bool = True, )
methods.description: Converts LiteLLM skills to Anthropic-style tools, injects skill content into system prompt, and adds code execution tools and skill files metadata.

methods.name: dict _process_non_anthropic_model( self, data: dict, litellm_skills: List[LiteLLM_SkillsTable], )
methods.description: Converts LiteLLM skills to OpenAI-style tools, injects content, adds code execution tools, and manages skill files for non-Anthropic models.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_SkillsTable] _fetch_skill_from_db(self, skill_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a skill record from the LiteLLM database given a skill ID.

methods.name: bool _is_anthropic_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if the given model is an Anthropic model by inspecting the provider configuration.

methods.name: Optional[Any] async_post_call_success_deployment_hook( self, request_data: dict, response: Any, call_type: Optional[CallTypes], )
methods.description: Handles response after a successful call, executing code if tool calls are detected, and looping until a final response is obtained.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _extract_tool_calls(self, response: Any)
methods.description: Extracts tool call information from different response formats (Anthropic or OpenAI).

methods.name: Any _execute_code_loop_messages_api( self, data: dict, response: Any, skill_files: Dict[str, bytes], )
methods.description: Implements a loop to execute code snippets via sandbox executor, updating conversation, and attaching generated files until completion.

methods.name: str _execute_code( self, code: str, skill_files: Dict[str, bytes], executor: Any, generated_files: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Executes a code string in the sandbox environment, returning the output and capturing generated files.

methods.name: str _execute_skill_tool( self, tool_name: str, tool_input: Dict[str, Any], skill_files: Dict[str, bytes], executor: Any, generated_files: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Generates and runs code for a skill tool, typically by importing skill modules and executing class methods to produce output and files.

methods.name: Any _execute_code_loop( self, data: dict, response: Any, skill_files: Dict[str, bytes], )
methods.description: Executes code snippets iteratively within the conversation until a final response is reached, managing files and response content.

methods.name: str _execute_code_tool( self, tool_call: Any, skill_files: Dict[str, bytes], executor: Any, generated_files: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Executes a code snippet contained within a tool call, capturing output and files.

methods.name: Any _attach_files_to_response( self, response: Any, generated_files: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Attaches generated files to the response object, making them accessible in the returned response.
